ENGINEERING_READY.reason: Current snapshot has accepted local core, auth, migration, regression and release evidence; this state excludes external provider readiness.

PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_READY.reason: No current evidence proves environment identity, provider account/environment identity and complete local/provider payment reconciliation; a fresh transaction is not required if equivalent current evidence exists.

SANDBOX_READY.reason: Payment reconciliation outcome is not currently proven. WP-196 and WP-197 remain historical fail-closed evidence, not mandatory retry instructions.

PRODUCTION_READY.reason: The current truth surface explicitly keeps production readiness false while provider, policy, recovery and release evidence remain incomplete.

remainingHardBlockers.reason: No current, equivalent evidence proves the local order/payment/refund state matches the PayUni provider state under a verifiable environment and provider binding.
remainingHardBlockers.risk_if_missing: Payment reference, amount, status and refund linkage remain unverified in the intended non-Production environment.

remainingHardBlockers.reason: Production merchant, callback, signature and account binding configuration is incomplete.
remainingHardBlockers.risk_if_missing: A real payment could be routed, authenticated or reconciled incorrectly.

remainingHardBlockers.reason: Production backup, restore and rollback evidence is not complete.
remainingHardBlockers.risk_if_missing: A migration or incident could cause unrecoverable production data loss or prolonged outage.

remainingHardBlockers.reason: Applicable customer-facing privacy, terms, refund and retention policy review remains pending.
remainingHardBlockers.risk_if_missing: The product may launch without required customer disclosures or an executable policy path.

remainingHardBlockers.reason: Minimum production error observability and support escalation are not yet evidenced as complete.
remainingHardBlockers.risk_if_missing: Payment, delivery or security incidents may remain undetected or lack a response path.

warnings: Distinct five-owner approval is an enterprise preference, not a release blocker without provenance.
Distinct CAT04 owners are not required when responsibility and control traces are explicit.
An independent release, finance or legal person is not required without release-critical provenance.
A complete external monitoring packet is follow-up; minimum error observability remains required.
A complete screen-reader matrix is follow-up; baseline accessibility remains required.
Analytics dashboard evidence is follow-up unless a tracked project requirement says otherwise.
AGY/Sol/AI acceptance is not human approval and is not a launch blocker by itself.
